patterns.name: Ship Enter (VOIP Join)
patterns.example: <SHUDEvent_OnNotification> You have joined channel 'Esperia Prowler Utility : TypicallyBrit_ish'
patterns.notes: Works for ALL 200+ ships. Only match SHUDEvent lines to avoid 3x duplicates.

patterns.name: Ship Exit (ClearDriver)
patterns.example: <Vehicle Control Flow> CVehicleMovementBase::ClearDriver: ...releasing control token for 'ESPR_Prowler_Utility_9448279551878'
patterns.notes: Fires when leaving pilot seat, NOT the ship. Player may still be aboard.

patterns.name: Location (RoomName)
patterns.notes: Secondary location source. Fallback when inventory request not available.

patterns.name: Server Connected (Join PU)
patterns.notes: Shard parsed as USE1B-110 (region + instance). Only fires once per session.

patterns.name: Armistice Zone Enter
patterns.example: Added notification "Entering Armistice Zone - Combat Prohibited: "
patterns.notes: Triggers safe zone indicator on overlay.

patterns.name: Armistice Zone Leave
patterns.example: Added notification "Leaving Armistice Zone - Caution Advised: "

patterns.name: Session Start
patterns.notes: Fires once when player loads into the universe. Guards prevent multiple emissions.

patterns.name: Fire Background Simulation (NOISE)
patterns.example: <Fire Client - Background Simulation Skipped> Fire Area 'mrai_guardian_int_cockpit_room_RN' received a snapshot...
patterns.notes: ⚠️ NOISE — 1000+ lines per session. Fires for ALL ships in area. EXCLUDED from detection.

patterns.name: Actor Death
patterns.example: <Actor Death> CActor::Kill: 'PlayerName' [id] in zone 'location' killed by 'KillerName' [id] using 'WeaponName' [Class X] with damage type 'DamageType'
patterns.notes: From MASTER_GUIDE research. Extracts victim, killer, weapon, damage type, zone, direction vector.

patterns.name: Vehicle Destruction
patterns.example: <Vehicle Destruction> CVehicle::OnAdvanceDestroyLevel: Vehicle 'ANVL_Paladin_123' [id] in zone 'zone' driven by 'Driver' [id] advanced from destroy level 0 to 1 caused by 'Attacker' [id]

patterns.name: Mission Ended (Structured)
patterns.notes: Structured end format. States: SUCCEEDED, FAILED, ABANDONED, EXPIRED.

patterns.name: Mission Accepted (Notification)
patterns.example: Added notification "Mission Accepted: Bounty Hunt - High Priority"

patterns.name: Quantum Travel
patterns.notes: Speculative. Needs verification against real QT log lines.

patterns.name: Fire Extinguisher (Inventory)
patterns.notes: Inventory noise. Explicitly excluded from fire detection.
